== Summary ==
Runner-up [[Casey Anis]] (in the "Goose" tie-dye shirt) at the streaming table after a game of the final, with spectators.

* '''Event:''' [[2023 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2023-08-14
* '''Camera date:''' 2023-08-13 19:18 EDT (23:18 UTC, from the original file name)
* '''Identification:''' [[Casey Anis]]: face match with the [[:File:2023 World Championship Top 8.jpg|Top 8 photo]], where he wears the same "Goose" tie-dye shirt. The others are not named.
